Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players of South Africa are out in the middle. Australia Women chased down 278 last time around against India Women and if they want to stay unbeaten in this competition, they have to do it once again. Here are Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes for Australia Women. Shabnim Ismail to start with the ball.
... THE CHASE ...

Right then! 272 runs to win for Australia Women. This clash was always about the Aussies batting against the bowling of the Proteas. Will South Africa Women be able to get a 'Q' next to their name? We will find out soon. The chase coming up shortly.

Laura Wolvaardt (90) comes for a quick word. She says that it's disappointing that she is not going all the way but is happy to contribute. Shares that it's a nice wicket to bat on. Praises Australia Women for their bowling and tells that they bowled well in the middle overs and had good plans. Hopes that the South Africa bowlers will do the same. Adds that she is happy with the stand towards the end between Chloe Tryon and Marizanne Kapp. On her stand with Sune Luus, Laura replies that it was a good one and they focused on rotating the strike. She is backing her bowling attack and hopes that 271 is enough. Feels that a couple of early wickets and it will be game on.

Australia Women would be relatively happy with the way they bowled on an excellent batting surface. They kept a lid on the scoring despite having Laura Wolvaardt, the set batter, around. Their bowling in the middle phase was also incredible. By pickings wickets at the backend, Australia Women managed to restrict the scoring however they would be a shade disappointed with the way they leaked runs in the last four overs.

A really good batting performance by South Africa Women. First, they managed to go unhurt while the ball was swinging initially. Just when Lizelle Lee was trying to up the ante, she fell. Lara Goodall came in and got a good start but failed to continue. Laura Wolvaardt batted brilliantly but she needed someone to help her from the other end. There was a quiet period in the middle but the skipper came with intent and started to shift gears. Wolvaardt brought up her fourth 50-plus score while Luus scored at a brisk rate. It was the partnership between them that propelled the South African innings. Just when it was time to launch, both fell in the span of 8 balls. South Africa needed a good end and it was provided by Kapp and Tryon.

43 coming off the last four overs. Just when the wheels were coming off for South Africa Women, Marizanne Kapp and Chloe Tryon did the repairing work quickly to give a good end to their innings. Still, Australia Women have done well to keep the score well below 300 which looked gettable at one stage. The Aussies broke the big partnership between Laura Wolvaardt and Sune Luus at a crucial time and that halted the charge for South Africa Women slightly.

Flatter and fuller around off, Chloe Tryon swings it over mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs. The quickfire stand between Marizanne Kapp and Chloe Tryon has helped South Africa Women finish on 271/5!
Jess comes from 'round the wicket and darts in a full ball around leg, Kapp clips it to square leg for a run.
FOUR! Cheeky! This is excellent from Kapp. Tossed up, full and around middle, Marizanne Kapp walks across the stumps, goes down and paddle scoops it past short fine leg.
A low full toss around off, Kapp walks forward and powers it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter and shorter on off, Marizanne Kapp mistimes her pull shot back to the bowler.
FOUR! A good way to start the final over. Flatter and shorter, down the leg side, Marizanne Kapp kneels down and muscles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Who will bowl the final over? It is Jess Jonassen.
On a length around off, Tryon walks forward and drags her shot to deep mid-wicket for two. 12 from the over, 30 in the last three!

SIX! That's connection personified! Megan Schutt goes wide of the crease and delivers it full and around off. It's in the slot for the batter and Chloe Tryon dispatches it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Pace off from Megan Schutt. A touch short and outside off, Chloe Tryon flashes and misses.
250 up! Back of a length, around off, punched on the up but wide of the bowler. It went to long off for a single.
Short and around off, Marizanne Kapp pulls it down to wide long on and scampers back for the second run.
Fullish around off, Chloe Tryon drags it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Marizanne Kapp is finishing it well for South Africa Women! Flighted and full, around middle, Marizanne Kapp steps back to make room and smacks it over extra cover. 10 from the over!
Flighted and down the leg side, Kapp tries to sweep but misses. Not called a wide, maybe it came off the gloves.
Loopy and full, around leg, Marizanne Kapp walks forward and chips it over mid off for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full and flighted, around leg, Marizanne Kapp sinks down on her back knee and powers it over mid-wicket for a bounday.
Quicker one, short and around leg, Kapp makes room to cut but finds the cover fielder.
Flatter and shorter around leg, punched back to the bowler.
Short again, around off, Marizanne Kapp pulls it without much conviction, down to long on for a run.
Chloe Tryon fetches a short ball from outside off and drags her pull shot down to long on for one.
A low full toss around leg, Tryon nudges it down towards long on and scampers back for the second run.
Direct hit could have been trouble. Short in length and outside off, Chloe Tryon goes back and punches it to covers. Meg Lanning misses her shy at the bowler's end and they cross for an overthrow.
Full and angling in, around middle, it's forced down to long on for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Chloe Tryon drives it down towards long off for a single.
Megan Schutt is back into the attack.
Flatter and around leg, skidding away, Marizanne Kapp pushes it from the leading half of her bat to the off side. Top over!
Chloe Tryon walks out to the middle.

OUT! THAT'S A SCREAMER! Yet another big wicket for the Aussies at the backend. There's nothing that Ashleigh Gardner can't do on a cricket field. This catch is surely for the highlights reel. Flighted one, full and around leg, Mignon du Preez shimmies down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket. It goes aerially to the deep and it appears that Ashleigh Gardner is standing a few steps ahead of the original position. She though backtracks well, keeps her eyes on the ball, jumps and plucks it out of thin air with her right hand. Big smile on her face. Australia Women are finishing strongly.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around leg, knocked down to long on for a single.
Shortish and on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Quicker and fuller around middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, punched to extra cover.
Jess Jonassen (7-0-27-0) comes back again to bowl.
Fuller and around leg, Mignon du Preez walks forward and drills it to long on for a run.

FOUR! Nice shot and a bad bounce results in the fielder failing to stop the ball. Tossed up, around off, Mignon du Preez heaves it over mid-wicket by going down on one knee. It drops safely in the deep, the fielder tries to stop it with one hand but it bounces extra and goes past her to find the fence.
Loopy and full outside off, Mignon du Preez tries to be inventive with here reverse-batted shot but fails to connect.
Flatter delivery, it's fired on the pads, Kapp helps it to the right of mid-wicket for one.
A touch short and on off, pushed off the back foot to cover-point for a single.
Flatter and a bit shorter on middle, worked in front of square leg for a run.
Knocks it down to long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, Mignon du Preez flicks it through square leg for a run.
Who comes now? Marizanne Kapp it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another good catch by Tahlia McGrath and Australia Women have successfully removed both the set batters in the span of 8 balls. A good passage of play for them. Megan Schutt serves it short and on middle, Sune Luus stands back to pull but fails to pack her shot with enough power. It flies behind square leg, Tahlia McGrath sprints forward from the deep and secures the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Walks across the stumps again and this time pulls it to the left of short fine leg for one.
On a length and outside off, Mignon du Preez flashes her blade at it and misses.
FOUR! Well played! A touch short in length, on middle and leg, Mignon shuffles across the stumps and pulls it fine down the fine leg region for a boundary. An excellent start to the over.
Megan Schutt is brought back.
Loopy and full, around off, Mignon du Preez sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and opens her account with a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Mignon du Preez pushes it towards mid off and Ashleigh Gardner makes a quick stop to her left.
Fuller and around off, Sune inside-edges her attempted heave to deep square leg for a run.
Mignon du Preez comes in now.

OUT! Laura holes out! She falls for a cause, looking for quick runs and it's a wonderful catch by Tahlia McGrath. Loopy and full, around off, Laura Wolvaardt skips down the track, looking for a big shot down the ground but fails to get the desired connection. It flies towards long off and Tahlia McGrath comes running across to her right to complete the catch with a slide. No century for Laura but she has played a very responsible knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Walks down the track to a full ball and nudges it in the gap at mid-wicket. This time they press hard and collect a couple of runs.
Short and down the leg side, Luss stays back and pulls it behind square leg for a run. That's poor running between the wickets.
Ashleigh Gardner (8-1-39-0) to bowl now.
FIFTY FOR LUUS! Off 48 balls. A knock of true intent from the skipper. Fuller and around middle, Sune Luus sweeps it to deep square leg for a run. She would look to finish on a high here.
Quicker and a bit shorter on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Flatter and around leg, defended back.
FOUR! Fine shot! Sune Luus moves to 49. Wrong line, a touch short and down the leg side, Sune goes down and clobbers it behind to fine leg for a boundary.

Aerial but safe! Floated and around middle, Laura tries to whip it across the line by advancing down the track. It takes the leading half of her blade and goes over mid off. The ball drops safely and they cross.
Jess Jonassen (6-0-20-0) is back on.
Loopy and full around middle, swept to long leg for a run. 200 up!
Good length, around leg, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Drifting down the leg side, some extra bounce, Sune Luus tries sweeping but fails to connect neatly.
On middle, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
Around off, on a length, helped towards square leg for one.
Top edge but clears the in-ring fielder. Short and around middle, Sune Luus tries to sweep but it takes the top edge and flies behind short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Serves it short and on middle, Laura Wolvaardt steps back and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 25-yard circle till the end of this innings.
FOUR! A boundary on the last ball and South Africa Women are cruising along nicely. Length ball, on the pads. Luus mistimes her sweep shot off the top edge and sends it to fine leg for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Luus tries to chase this wayward delivery but misses.
On middle, fuller delivery, Wolvaardt works it wide of long on for a single.
Full and follows Wolvaardt on the leg side. She drives it well but finds mid off.
Angling on the pads. Luus helps it away to fine leg for a run.
On middle, it is eased down to mid on for a single.
And that will be six singles off the over! Around off. Wolvaardt plays it to long on. The batters looked for another run but the fielder there ran across quickly.
Make it five singles! Length again, around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Length and on off, this is hit to deep cover for the fourth single in a row!
Slightly short, slower again and on off. Luus pulls it in front of square leg for a single.
Slants a full ball, on the pads, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for another run.
A length ball, slower and angling on middle, Luus bunts it to mid-wicket for a run.
Megan Schutt (5-0-16-0) is back on.
A single as this full ball is drilled down to long on. 12 runs coming off the over. Just what South Africa Women wanted.
Full and on off. Luus hammers it straight, past the diving mid off fielder and long on cuts it out. The batters take two runs.
Pitches it up, on off, it is nudged to mid-wicket.
Meg Lanning has a word with her bowler. Maybe, that prompted for a change in the field.
Five wides! Bonus runs! Fuller ball, way outside off. Luus leaves it alone. The keeper fails to collect and the ball races away to the third man fence.
On a length, on middle. Luus flicks it to mid-wicket. A bit uppish but it falls safely.
Outside off, this time she fails to create the gap, hits it straight to point.
FOUR! Good start to the over! Length ball, outside off. Luus guides it, not off the middle but gets the gap towards backward point for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Tahlia McGrath is brought back into the attack. Her 2 overs have gone for 10 runs.
A quicker ball, full and on middle. Wolvaardt wrists it to square leg, not in the gap though.
Fullish and outside off, this is hit to long off for one more. The 50-run partnership is up, off 58 balls.
Tossed up, on middle, Wolvaardt paddles it to deep square leg for a single.
This is very full and on middle. Wolvaardt jams it back to the bowler.
An easy single as Luus drills this full ball to long on.
Shorter and slanting on middle. Wolvaardt clears her front leg and works it to mid-wicket. A single is taken.

Drinks break. South Africa Women have navigated quite decently through the middle overs and still have a set batter in Laura Wolvaardt available for the backend. That's a big boost for them. 14 overs left in the innings and they will be aiming to breach the 300-run mark. Australia's game plan will be to limit the damage and that's mainly possible by taking wickets. Let's see who succeeds.
Angles a full ball, on middle, Wolvaardt pushes it through cover-point for a run. 16 runs in the last two overs.
Well down the leg side. Luus sweeps it in front of square leg for a single.
Flatter and around off. Wolvaardt hangs back and punches it to deep cover for a run.
On middle, fuller, Sune sweeps it to fine leg for one more.
FOUR! Good shot! In the channel, around off, Sune Luus once again slog-sweeps it over wide mid on and bags another boundary. The skipper has shifted gears.
Advances down the track to a full ball and drills it back past the bowler for a run as long off cuts it off.
Tossed up, on off, Luus is a touch early as she tries to flick this. It goes off the leading edge but is well short of the bowler.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Tossed up, on middle, Luus slog-sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary. Luus accelerating things now.
Flatter and on middle, Wolvaardt rocks back and nudges it through mid-wicket for a run.
Over the wicket now! Short and outside off, cut away to deep cover for a single.
A friendly full toss, on off and Luus hits it back to Gardner.
Flighted, full and on off, it is eased down to long off for a single.
There's a bowling change. Ashleigh Gardner (6-1-28-0) is back on.
Short and on off. Luus cuts but straight to point.
Flatter and on off. Wolvaardt punches off the back foot to long off for a single.
A loopy ball, on off, Laura knocks it to extra cover, straight to the fielder.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.

Full and down the leg side. Luus sweeps it fine to the fine leg region. Schutt runs to her right, dives and does really well to save a couple of runs. Megan Schutt has been incredible on the field today. The umpires get it checked upstairs. The replays show that when she is in contact with the rope, the ball is already released. Her hair though nearly made a contact with the ball. Surely that would not have counted.
Floated, full and outside off. Wolvaardt strokes it to deep cover for one more.
Tossed up, on off. Luus sweeps it straight to square leg.
Luus hits this full ball to cover-point.
FOUR! Much needed! Tossed up, on off, Luus gets low and hammers it well over mid on for a boundary.
Another dot ball! Flatter and on off. Luus taps it onto the off side. Finds the cover fielder.
Around off, full and this is worked to covers.
Full and down the leg side, swept to deep backward square leg for one. The replays showed that the two batters nearly ran into each other.
Tad short and around off. Wolvaardt cuts it to deep point for a single. South Africa Women need a shift in gears now.
Full, straight on middle, pushed straight to the fielder at covers.
Very full and angling on leg, Laura hits it to mid on.
Short and around off. Wolvaardt looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Just wide of mid on! A full toss, around off. Wolvaardt comes down the track and smashes it to the left of mid on for a welcome boundary.
Flighted in the air, full and on middle, driven to covers for a single.
Change in bowling. Alana King is back for another spell. 1/13 in her 4 overs so far.
Full and outside off. Luus drags it and hits it over mid-wicket for another single.
Floated, full and on off. Wolvaardt creates room and drives it to long off for a single.
An arm ball, sliding on middle. Luus swipes it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off, drilled to long off for a single.
Full again, on leg. Wolvaardt skips down and tucks it straight to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
Around off, on a length, Sune hangs back and tries to steer it past backward point but her plan flops as the fielder stops it with a dive.
Beaten! Fuller and outside off, Sune Luus tries to drive but misses.

Short and wide outside off, Laura Wolvaardt throws her hands at it and slaps it to deep point for a single. Laura Wolvaardt now becomes the leading run-scorer of this edition of the ICC Women's World Cup, going past Rachael Haynes.
On a length around middle, angling in, Laura gets back and works it to mid-wicket.
Pitches it up and outside off, Laura strokes off the front but picks out extra cover.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers.

'CATCH IT'...is the shout but it falls well short! Tossed up, full and around leg, Laura shimmies down the track and lofts it over mid on. Not much timing and it doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep. They take a single.
Flighted around leg, Laura Wolvaardt tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Bowls this one with a round-arm action. Full and sliding down, Sune gloves her attempted sweep shot down to fine leg. They cross.
Quicker and around off, defended back.
Loopy and full, around off, Sune defends it off the front foot.
Flighted and full around leg, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Zipping off the surface from around off, on a good length and cramping the batter for room, Sune loses her balance but somehow keeps it out safely on the leg side.
Outside off, dabbed down to third man for one.
Short again outside off, this time Laura Wolvaardt whacks it to deep point for two.
Short in length and wide outside off, played down to point.
In the channel outside off, Sune Luus guides it down to third man for a run.

OUT! CAUGHT! A knock of good intent comes to an end! Annabel Sutherland pitches it up and takes the pace off it. It's a cutter. Lara Goodall attempts to loft it over mid off but it comes from the lower half of her bat and flies towards Alana King inside the ring who catches it by moving to her left. Smart captaincy by Meg Lanning to have the field up in that region and Annabel Sutherland bowled according to the plan.
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Annabel Sutherland

Commentary.Commentary: The skipper, Sune Luus walks out to the middle.
Wide! Back of a length, down the leg side, Lara Goodall tries to glance but misses.
Eases this one down to long on and picks up a single.
Quicker one, very full and around leg, Lara Goodall tries to play the paddle shot but it takes the toe end of her bat and rolls to mid-wicket.
Plenty of undercut on this delivery. Landing outside off and skidding away, Goodall tries to play on the leg side but misses.
Flighted and outside off, smashed wide of the bowler. It's aerial but goes safely to mid off.
Nearly a return catch. Around off, skidding in, Lara tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It doesn't carry to the bowler.
Full and around middle, defended back.
A quick concussion test for Laura Wolvaardt as she gets hit on the helmet. She looks completely fine. Also, Jess Jonassen is back on.
FOUR LEG BYES! Annabel Sutherland digs it another short ball in this over, Laura Wolvaardt goes back to pull but misses. It pings her on the helmet and flies behind the keeper for a boundary.
Angling in from around middle, eased down to mid on.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and around leg, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Pitches it up and around off, Lara Goodall gets on the front foot and pushes it towards mid on.
Serves it on a good length around middle, Lara tries to flick but misses and gets hit high on the front leg.
Annabel Sutherland (3-0-17-0) is back into the attack.
Floated and around leg, it's clipped down to fine leg for a run. This stand has moved to 21.
A conventional sweep shot from Laura Wolvaardt as she sends this full ball to deep square leg for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Lara Goodall knocks it down to mid on and takes on the fielder. She gets a risky single. Direct hit could have been close.
Ooohhh...nearly bowled around the legs. Full and around leg, Lara Goodall tries to play the reverse-batted shot but fails to connect.
Two wides! Spinning down the leg side, Laura Wolvaardt goes down and tries to sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect and they cross.
Flatter and around off, a bit on the shorter side, Laura goes back and hits it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This one has been smashed! Full and flighted outside off, Laura Wolvaardt walks down the track and hammers it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Loopy and full, outside off, Lara Goodall picks it up and goes with the spin. She has heaved it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
FIFTY! Laura Wolvaardt drives a full ball to sweeper cover for a single. This is now her fourth 50-plus score!
Quicker, flatter and shorter, around leg, punched back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, worked straight to mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Laura cuts but finds the point fielder.
Fullish and around off, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Floated and full, around off, it's driven back and Ashleigh Gardner makes a diving stop to her left.
Fires a quicker one, around middle and leg, Lara clips it through square leg for a single.
Fullish and close to off, Lara Goodall bends her back knee a bit and dinks it towards short fine leg for two.
Flighted and full, around middle, defended down to mid on.
Short and around off, Laura Wolvaardt goes back and drags her pull shot down to long leg for a single.
Loopy and full, around off, defended back from the inner half of the bat.
Flatter and around leg, nudged in front of square on the leg side. Maiden!
Quicker and around middle, again it's pushed back in the direction of Alana King.
Shortish and on off, a mistimed punch rolls back to the bowler again.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it back.
Fuller and around middle, paddled down towards short fine leg.
Flighted and around off, Lara Goodall defends it back.
Slightly short and outside off, Goodall goes back and taps it down wide of point for a single. She is off the mark!
Floated and full, around off, Lara presses forward and defends it back.
Loopy and full around off, Laura drives it to the left of the cover fielder for a quick run.
Short and on middle, it's pulled across the line but towards square leg. No run.
Flighted and full, around middle, it's flicked with the spin to square leg.
Short around off, skidding away, Laura Wolvaardt goes back to pull but misses.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Flighted ball, on middle, Goodall works it to mid-wicket.
Lara Goodall is slotted to come in next at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Finally, a breakthrough for Australia Women and it looked like the wicket will come from King. She gets one here! A flatter ball, it lands around leg and turns away towards off. Lee looks to defend off the front leg but gets beaten by the spin. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. She walks across and has a conversation with her partner and walks back without taking the review. Three reds on the Ball Tracking.
Tossed up, on middle. Kept out.
On middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! Ohh, what happened there? This is short and on middle, Lizelle Lee goes on the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket. Ashleigh Gardner rushes across to her left and then goes down to collect it. The ball though spins on the second bounce and the fielder ends up getting wrong-footed. It clips her ankle and deflects behind to find the fence. Not entirely her mistake but the body language of Ashleigh after that wasn't too great.
Slower ball, length and outside off, Lee drops it in front of point for a quick single.
A low dipping full toss, on off, Lee leans and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Length, outside off. Left alone by Lee.
A quick short ball, outside off. Lee rides the bounce as she pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Wide outside off. Wolvaardt reaches and hits it to deep cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Lee slaps it to the left of covers and the batters take a single.
Shorter and on off, Wolvaardt chops it down to point. Not in the gap though.
Flatter and around off. Wolvaardt eases it off the front foot to covers.
Floated, full and on middle. Wolvaardt stays back to play it towards point.
Full and on leg. Kept out.

Lovely delivery from King! Tossed up, on middle, it lands and spins away. Wolvaardt, on the back foot, looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge and speeds past the keeper to third man. They cross. King nearly got the breakthrough there!
Starts with a freebie, a full toss, on middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Alana King to bowl her leggies after the break. Will she get any purchase from this surface?

Drinks break. Smooth going for South Africa Women thus far. Laura Wolvaardt has taken the charge with the bat and her opening partner Lizelle Lee has now started to score freely. It's a nice platform upfront. For Australia Women, the bowling has been decent. There isn't much on offer for the bowlers and keeping that in mind, they have done a reasonable job on an excellent batting turf. Let's see what's in store for the middle overs.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Again, this is quite outside off and fuller as well. Wolvaardt tries to chase this one and misses.
Full ball, wide outside off, this ball just nips away off the surface. Laura flashes at it and misses.
A single as this is hammered down to long leg.
FOUR! Really well played! A length ball, on off. Lee steps forward and wrists it through square leg for a boundary. Her bottom hand comes into the play there.
Full ball, away movement, outside off. Lee pushes it to covers.
Short ball now, outside off. Lee pulls it, all along the ground and to deep mid-wicket and she will keep the strike.
Change in bowling. Tahlia McGrath is introduced into the attack.
Short of a length, outside off. Laura cuts it past point for a single.
Around off, on a length. Blocked out.
On middle, pulled away to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! This will release some pressure! Fuller, slower and around off. Lee lifts it nicely over mid off and bags a boundary, her first.
Length and on off. Lee mistimes her pull, back to the bowler.

Tossed up, full and on middle, Lee gets low and looks to sweep it. An appeal for LBW but nothing is given. King, meanwhile, gives a chase and tries to flick it back near the fine leg fence but she slips and falls awkwardly. She though does well to stay away from the rope. The batters take three runs.
Angles across a full ball, around off, this is drilled to long on for a single.
Targets the pads, flicked to square leg this time.
Gardner comes around the wicket and serves it full and on leg. Wolvaardt is happy to keep it out.
Flatter and on off, Lee waits for the ball and plays it late to short third man for a single.
Very full and outside off, Wolvaardt drives it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and wide outside off. Wolvaardt smashes it to sweeper cover for a single to end the over.
Length ball, on off. Wolvaardt defends it towards cover.
Shorter and on middle. Laura evades it as she ducks under it.
Fuller and angling on middle, Wolvaardt forces it to deep square leg and Megan Schutt has to cover some ground, as she runs to her left and saves a couple of runs.
On middle, on a length. Lee flicks it in front of square leg for one more.
Length and on the pads. Wolvaardt helps it away to fine leg for a single.
First maiden of the innings goes to Ashleigh Gardner! Quicker one, on middle. Lee turns it to square leg.
A bit of flight there, full and on off, Lee hits it to covers.
Floated, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Turn there! Full ball, outside off, turning in. Lee looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fumbles a bit but no run is taken.
Fuller and outside off. Lee presses forward and defends it to point.
Tossed up, on off. Lee lunges and plays back to the bowler.
Around off, on a length, this is hit to mid off.
Length and on middle, Wolvaardt wrists it uppishly but well wide of the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Proper timing! Length and around middle, Laura Wolvaardt punches it past mid on for a boundary. 50 up!
WIDE! Bangs in a short ball, on middle. Wolvaardt sits under it and the umpire signals a wide for height.
Again cannot find the gap at covers. Fuller and outside, this has been pushed more from the outside portion of the bat.
Length and on off. This time Wolvaardt hits but straight to the fielder at covers.
Good start from Annabel Sutherland! This is a touch fuller, outside off, Wolvaardt, without much foot movement, looks to drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bowling change. Annabel Sutherland to have a go now..
Full and outside off, Wolvaardt prods and pushes it to covers for a single.
Flatter, slower in the air and on off. Wolvaardt defends it on the deck.
FOUR! Good shot! This was short and on off. Wolvaardt gets into position to pull and she hits it hard to square leg for a boundary. A welcome boundary for South Africa Women.
Tossed up, full and on off. Lee turns it in front of square leg for one more.
Slightly short, slower as well and this is pulled to deep square leg for one run.
A length ball, on off. Wolvaardt steps across and bunts it to square leg.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, Australia Women can place a maximum of 4 fielders outside the inner circle till the 40th over. Ashleigh Gardner to bowl now...
Flighted and on middle, skidding down, Laura Wolvaardt works it to deep backward square leg for a run. End of a wicket-less Powerplay 1 - South Africa Women are 41/0!
Flatter and on off, it's nudged off the inner edge to backward square leg for a run.
Arm ball, around middle and leg, Laura Wolvaardt gets across and tucks it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Quicker and fuller around middle, it's swept behind square leg for one.
Short in length, around off, Laura pulls but without much timing. It goes to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Laura drives it straight to covers.
Stays back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single. It's been a decent start from South Africa Women!
Pitches it up and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it through the line but finds backward point.
Nearly drags it on! Fullish and outside off, shaping in, Laura Wolvaardt tries to drive but gets a big inside edge onto the pads.
Short in length and around off, Laura pulls it aerially and in front of square on the leg side. The outfield is heavy due to the overnight rain. It's a couple.
Full again, around off and angling in, Lizelle Lee goes down and sweeps it to long leg for a run.
Fullish and around off, Lee strokes it down the ground but finds mid off.
Flatter and full, around off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up around middle, Lee top-edges her sweep shot down to long leg for one.
Quicker arm ball around middle, Lizelle Lee closes the face early and it goes off the leading edge to point.
A bit short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Skidding in from around off, Laura Wolvaardt goes back and forces it to point.
Flatter and on off, punched to covers.
Jess Jonassen is into the attack.

Lizelle Lee could have been in trouble there! Fullish and around off, it's a defensive push from Laura Wolvaardt as she places it to the left of Meg Lanning at covers. Calls for one and Lizelle Lee responds but is a bit late in taking off. Makes it safely as it's not a direct hit.
Goes full and around off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it down the ground but finds mid off.
The line is too straight and Laura Wolvaardt tucks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Angling in from around off, Lizelle Lee tucks it behind square leg and collects one.
Finds the gap with her drive and the ball races away to sweeper cover. Laura Wolvaardt takes a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
Full in length and around off, moving away off the pitch, Lizelle Lee tries to defend the line but gets beaten by the slight movement.

Sharp single. Full this time, around off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it to covers where the fielder goes down to her left and parries it behind towards point. They cross for a hesitant single and Lizelle Lee takes no chance and makes it safely with a dive. She was run out in the match against New Zealand and has learnt her lessons.
Play and a miss! Short again, outside off and shaping away, Laura Wolvaardt tries to slam it through point but misses.
Width there outside off, short in length, Laura cuts but finds the point fielder.
Wide! This one is delivered on a length and wide outside off. There is an away swing as well. Laura leaves and it has been wided.
Back of a length, around off, Laura stays on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Finds the gap and collects a couple of runs.
Short in length and around off, angling in, Laura Wolvaardt stands back and pulls it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
On a length, on middle. Blocked out.

Length ball, drifting on middle. Lee gets low and sweeps it to the fine leg region. Perry runs from the deep backward square leg region and makes a good stop to save a couple of runs. The umpire just wants to get it confirmed upstairs and the replay shows that Perry did well near the ropes.
Slightly short and on off. Lee pushes it to covers.
On middle, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Wolvaardt flicks with the bat and pad together. The ball goes off the inside edge, brushes the pads and balloons near the vacant short leg region.
Length ball, Schutt getting that inward shape. Wolvaardt drops it to covers.
Full ball, swinging away, outside off. Wolvaardt knocks it to covers where a fumble allows a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Well bowled! A short ball, on middle. Wolvaardt misses her pull. No damage was done on the freebie.
Free Hit coming...
NO BALL! A full toss, well over the waist height, outside off. Wolvaardt leaves it alone. The umpire calls it an illegal delivery.
Very full and on off. Wolvaardt drives it nicely but straight to the fielder at point.
A length ball, around off, a bit of away swing there. Wolvaardt leans and defends it towards point.
Length ball, outside off. Wolvaardt plays it very late and towards gully. No run there.
Overpitched, on off, it is driven to sweeper cover for a run.
Around off, pushed to covers. Three dots in a row...
Full again, on off. Wolvaardt looks to drive towards mid off but it takes the inside edge and she gets hit on the pads.
Full and on middle. Wolvaardt works it on the leg side.

This is very full and swinging around middle and leg. Lee strides to flick this but it looked like the ball went off the bat to square leg for a single. The keeper thinks it's pad first and appeals for it. Nothing doing. There was an inside edge.
A length ball, on off. Lee nudges it to short mid-wicket. She wants a quick single but is sent back wisely.
On a length, around off. Wolvaardt blocks it. An expensive start for Perry, 10 runs coming off her first.
Length and on off. Wolvaardt dabs it to gully but can't get past Beth Mooney present there. A good stop.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Perry pitches it up, just outside off. Wolvaardt leans and drives it wide of covers and the ball races away to the boundary in a flash.
Wide! Fuller and down the leg side. Wolvaardt misses her whip. Wide given.
On a length, around off. Wolvaardt punches it to covers.
FOUR! Wolvaardt is underway as well! Width offered, on a length and well outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it uppishly but through cover-point for a boundary.
Short of a length, on middle, Lee pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Ellyse Perry to bowl from the opposite end. One slip is in place...
Schutt again goes wide of the crease, drags her length a bit back and keeps it outside off. Wolvaardt has a poke at it and misses. Good start from Schutt.
Pitched up, around off. Wolvaardt tucks it more off the inner half of the bat and to square leg.
Schutt goes wide of the crease and bowls it full and just outside off. Wolvaardt defends with soft hands.
Lee is off the mark now! Fullish and slanting on the pads. Lee tickles it to the long leg region and a single is taken.
Fuller and on middle. Lee keeps it out on the leg side.
Wide! Swing again! Full and down the leg side. Lee misses her flick. A wide given and South Africa Women are underway.
Schutt starts with a length ball, some swing there as the ball angles on the pads. Lee takes a big stride forward to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.

All in readiness now. The players from both groups are in the middle and they take the knee, as has been the tradition. Australia Women are spreading on the field while Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt are the openers for South Africa Women. Megan Schutt to bowl the first over. Let's play...
We are all set for the action but first, we will have national anthems of both teams. It is Australia's first followed by South Africa's.

Tahlia McGrath is up for a quick chat. She says she made her debut against South Africa but it was not worth remembering. Adds that the training is intense and when you put such effort it becomes easier during the game. Tells both teams know about each other well due to Womens' BBL.

Pitch report - A genuine cricket ground with generous conditions for the batters and bowlers, says Ian Smith. Nasser Hussain joins in and says that the surface still has plenty of grass there. Informs that it rained last evening and the conditions are humid and it may swing upfront. Bowling full could be helpful, feels Nass.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Lara Goodall (In for Tazmin Brits), Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Tumi Sekhukhune (In for Masabata Klaas).

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Rachael Haynes, Alyssa Healy (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Annabel Sutherland (In for Darcie Brown), Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt.

Sune Luus, the captain of South Africa Women, says that they wanted to bowl first as well to utilize the conditions but she also thinks that the conditions won't change much throughout. Adds that they have a fairly good idea about the Aussie players as they play in the Women's BBL with them. Informs that they have made a couple of changes - Tumi Sekhukhune comes in for Masabata Klaas who is out with a shoulder injury and Lara Goodall replaces Tazmin Brits.

Meg Lanning, the captain of Australia Women, says that it's a new wicket and it will play similarly throughout and they want to make use of the early conditions. Informs about the one change in their XI - Darcie Brown is out and Annabel Sutherland is in. Regarding this change, Lanning replies that they will have to manage Darcie but at the same time, Annabel coming in won't weaken them at all.
Toss - Australia Women win the toss and ELECT TO BOWL!

Five games, five wins and Australia Women are riding the wave of momentum. If you leave their first game, they have almost gone unchallenged. Although their last game against India Women got a bit nervy towards the end, a win for the Aussies was never in doubt. Can you say the same about South Africa Women? Perhaps not. Their first two games were neat and tidy but the last two games have been nerve-wracking to say the least. They got out of jail against both England Women and New Zealand Women and can be considered lucky. That said, their whole unit has experienced that kind of pressure and will be ready for the challenge that Australia Women will bring. If South Africa pass this litmus test, that will give their title ambitions a massive boost. Plenty to gain still for these two top teams.

Hola, you beautiful people! We hope you're enjoying every moment of the ICC Women's World Cup 2022. Things have certainly started to heat up on the table as the business end of the tournament is approaching. This match though is away from the mad race to get into the semis. Both Australia Women and South Africa Women have left the chasing pack behind with the former already getting a 'Q' next to their name and the latter having their one leg in the semi-final. All seems hunky-dory for them and this clash is more about the bragging rights. The fight for supremacy, the fight to stay unbeaten, the fight to show who the real boss is! One thing is certain, if the rain gods don't play spoilsport, this day will end up disrupting the winning momentum of one team. Will it be of Australia's or South Africa's? We don't have any favourites, you can decide for yourself. Stay tuned for more updates...
